## About
Eugenes Body Shop is a full-service collision center in the heart of Van Nuys, serving neighbors across the San Fernando Valley. We handle minor fender benders and major collision repairs, plus auto paint, frame work and windshield replacement.
We've run the same body shop for years, and a lot of our customers come from nearby Sherman Oaks, Studio City, North Hollywood, Burbank, Reseda and Encino. We'll tell you honestly when a bumper can be repaired instead of replaced.
Reviewers often mention Alex and Mark by name for being friendly, answering calls and keeping them updated. We're rated 4.7 from 45 Google reviews, and we'd like to earn yours.

## Services
- Minor collision repairs: Front and rear bumper damage, plus scratches and dents on driver or passenger side doors.
- Major collision repairs: Frame realignment and replacement of damaged parts like bumpers, headlights, doors, windshields and rims.
- Auto paint: Our technicians handle auto painting, matching the original color of your vehicle after repairs.
- Bumper repair or replacement: We know when a bumper can be repaired instead of replaced, which can save you money.
- Frame pulls and measurement: Precise measurement of frame pulls so your vehicle is restored accurately.
- Suspension: After a front end collision, your suspension will most likely need correction. We handle it.
- Auto glass repair: If a rock or object hits your windshield, we'll handle the replacement.
- Dents and dings: We remove everyday scuffs and dings and bring back the shine.

## FAQ
Q: Can I skip paying my deductible?
A: Maybe. Every accident is different, so we'll look at your case and see if it qualifies for a no deductible payment.

Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No. Give us a call and schedule a free estimate.

Q: Do you serve areas outside Van Nuys?
A: Yes. Customers come to us from Sherman Oaks, Studio City, North Hollywood, Burbank, Reseda and Encino.
